observation.visible_scene: A close point-of-view shot of a hooded figure wearing a white skull mask who is aiming a shotgun directly at the lens; the gun's forend/pump and a black-gloved hand fill the right foreground, while the backdrop is an interior bank lobby bearing a 'BANK' sign and recessed ceiling lights, with a brick wall and glass windows visible at the segment's outer frames.
visible_changes: The masked gunman maintains a steady aim on the lens throughout; his torso and the shotgun's orientation relative to the camera change only slightly (minor sway), so he stays roughly centered in frame.

The background transitions from an exterior brick-and-window wall (early frames) to an interior bank lobby where the 'BANK' lettering appears and becomes legible (mid frames), then drifts back toward brick/glass near the end.

The 'BANK' sign slides horizontally across the frame (entering from center-right, moving left, then returning), and the ceiling/horizon line tilts and rolls (changing Dutch angle), indicating camera rotation/translation relative to the scene rather than the gunman vacating his position.
Heavy motion blur on the left background in the first and last frames eases in the middle, consistent with faster camera movement at the segment boundaries.
The right-foreground gloved hand gripping the shotgun forend remains in essentially the same position relative to the lens across all frames.
outside_clip_unknowns: Who holds the camera and what the gunman is reacting to; whether the gunman is advancing, retreating, or stationary; the cause of the camera roll; events before t=0 and after t=3.2s (both ends are arbitrary crop boundaries).
uncertain_details: Whether the apparent background motion is the gunman moving through space or the camera operator moving; ownership of the foreground glove (gunman's hand vs. another person); exact layout of the bank entrance.
